test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of a cube are shown. What will come opposite to the face showing '@'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94e42c72a2fe185c42c1ee134c1accf54121a319a734522e47f5b8dff7ee6484.png]
solution:
In the given figure we observe:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4f785286b620efa822ab941f32ae827bbc8715b1fbe72920fcefe4950b7a238.png] 

When the dice is turned with one face fixed we get 4 surrounding faces of the given dice.

In this case we have 'infinity' sign fixed at one place and we get 4 sides and when we compare both the figures we can see that,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14d8f0c41f0e51fd9bab5977b3d5576d5d375287014e128e6ba1aacecd75549.png] 

**'1' replaces '@' and 'A' replaces 'triangle'**

which means **'triangle' is opposite to 'A' and '1' is opposite to '@'.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
